audit.definition: Climactic Mazama airborne bulk fallout. 31 point values, 137 lower limits and 103 upper limits are shared by all five families. Core duplicates and inferred phase totals carry explicit qualifications. The current input incorporates the published Yellowstone core data, Lyman Lake and the Ruby Mountain, Great Salt Lake, Mazama source and thicknessless-site reviews, Young’s separately mapped upper pumice sections, the Round Meadow borings, North Cascades and British Columbia lake cores, northern Idaho lake packages, Mount Baker field sections and the distal deposit-nature revision. Bounds and sensitivity alternatives are in the locality ledger.

source_checks.normalization: Analytical circular kernels; component centres can move away from the vent.

reproducibility.normalization: Finite-Earth component normalization followed by positive quadrature of retained mass under each normalized parent mixture.

bearing.posterior_interpretation: Parent amplitude and kernel parameters follow the original posterior. The principal mass is its integrated retained fraction times parent volume. A single latent orientation applies to a complete deposit.
bearing.numerical_interpretation: NUTS diagnostics and attempt histories describe parent draws. Each fit separately records spatial integration and split-draw checks on derived volume.

parent_reference_km3.interpretation: 95% equal-tailed Bayesian credible interval conditional on this likelihood, prior and field family.
